Class SaveData

java.lang.Object
save.SaveData
public class SaveData extends Object
Progress and settings, kept in a small file in the user's home folder: finished levels, window size, volume, invincible mode, validated checkpoints, lights, doors locked open, last checkpoint and controls. The aquascape.save system property can point it to another file.
